title: WorkFlowy SSE Frame Envelope
description:
Normative JSON Schema for every frame body emitted on the SSE channels `/stream/page/{pageId}` and `/stream/user/{ownerId}` per ADR-0025. Frame bodies are PascalCase JSON objects carried in the `data:` field of `text/event-stream` payloads. The `event:` line value MUST equal the body's `Event` field value (gate G-CON-03-SSE-EVENT-LINE-PARITY). The closed event-name set is owned by ADR-0025 §D2 and enforced by `G-25-SSE-EVENT-NAMES-CLOSED`.

Frames are READ-SIGNAL only — they MUST NOT enqueue to the offline FIFO replay queue (ADR-0023 §D1, gate `G-25-SSE-READ-ONLY-SIGNAL`).
$comment: Discriminator: the `Event` field selects the variant. Implementations MUST validate the union and reject unknown event names with the `resync` recovery contract from ADR-0025 §D4.

ItemId.description: ULID-shaped ItemId per ADR-0020. In TS this is the branded `ItemId` type from envelope.types.ts.

SortOrder.description: Fractional-index base-62 string per ADR-0016. Lexicographic sort = visual sort. NEVER cast to number.

ServerSeq.description: Monotonically increasing per-channel sequence. Mirrors the SSE `id:` line value (also used as `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect per ADR-0025 §D4).

ServerTs.description: ISO 8601 server-minted timestamp. SOLE timestamp consulted by the LWW guard (ADR-0026); client `clientTs` is ignored — gate `G-26-LWW-NO-CLIENT-TS`.

ItemType.description: Closed enum of 12 ItemTypes per ADR-0015. The `mirror` slot is legacy; new items use the peer-group model (ADR-0005).

Patch.description: Sparse patch — only the changed fields. PascalCase keys per ADR-0004.

PeerGroupId.description: null when the item left a peer group via detach (singleton dissolve, ADR-0005).

ItemMovedFrame.description: Pure structural move — `Id` is stable; only `ParentId` and/or `SortOrder` change (per ADR data-model §move semantics).

ItemTrashedFrame.description: Soft-delete to trash (30-day retention per mem://features/trash-logic).

MirrorLinkedFrame.description: Two or more items joined a peer group, OR a new pair was created. Carries the FULL current member set per ADR-0005 §M2 (never a delta) so clients reconcile by replacement.

MemberIds.description: MUST contain ≥2 ItemIds — `mirror.linked` for a singleton is forbidden (singletons are dissolved per ADR-0005 §M3, gate `G-MIRROR-DISSOLVE-SINGLETON`). Use `mirror.detached` to signal dissolution.

MirrorDetachedFrame.description: An item left a peer group. `Outcome` discriminates the post-detach group state per ADR-0005 §M3.

Outcome.description: `detach-shrink`: group still has ≥2 members; PeerGroupId persists. `detach-dissolve`: group fell to 1 member, so the singleton's PeerGroupId was set to NULL in the same transaction (ADR-0005 §M3, gate `G-ADR-0005-DISSOLVE-IN-TX`).

RemainingIds.description: MUST be present when `Outcome=detach-shrink` (lists ≥2 surviving member IDs). MUST be absent or empty when `Outcome=detach-dissolve`.

ResyncFrame.description: Cold-gap recovery frame per ADR-0025 §D4. The server emits exactly ONE `resync` frame when `Last-Event-ID + 1` is no longer in the 5-minute ring buffer. The client MUST respond by tearing down its local view of the channel and triggering a full REST snapshot reload — it MUST NOT continue applying subsequent SSE frames until the snapshot completes (gate `G-25-SSE-LAST-EVENT-ID`).

Reason.description: Diagnostic only — clients MUST NOT branch behaviour on Reason; the recovery action is identical for all three.

ChannelKind.description: Echoes which endpoint family triggered the resync — informational.
